terms.comment: Greek γεωγραφία, the description of the earth. Cicero promised Atticus a geography (Att. 2.4.3) and soon had second thoughts: magnum opus est (2.6.1). A map is tabula geōgraphica (see map).

phrases.latin: dē geōgraphiā dabō operam ut tibi satis faciam; sed nihil certī polliceor. magnum opus est
phrases.english: On the geography, I’ll do my best to satisfy you; but I promise nothing definite. It’s a big job

phrases.latin: dē geōgraphiā etiam atque etiam dēlīberābimus
phrases.english: about the geography, I shall think it over again and again

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 204, 320.
Cicero’s letters checked against the Perseus Latin texts (9 November 2026).
